title: plugins: sharing `expandRole` and approvals role-tier recipients read sys_member at a 10,000-row bound and turn a failed read into an empty list, so a large or unreadable membership silently shrinks the set
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① same-family observation of the #29281 dev (os-dev-report 6577634380, `out_of_scope_findings`), source reading only, not reproduced. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · the same defect class as #29281 (a membership read at its bound, or a failed read, silently shrinks a set), at a 10× larger bound.

Reach: an organization or role whose `sys_member` rows pass 10,000, or a moment when that read fails.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (plugin-sharing, plugin-approvals).

## What happens (source reading)

- `plugin-sharing` `team-graph.ts` `expandRole` (~L233) reads `sys_member` with `limit: 10000`, and a failed read is caught and becomes `[]`.
- `plugin-approvals` `approval-service.ts` role-tier recipients (~L3365) read the same way: `limit: 10000`, `catch → []`.
- So past 10,000 rows the expanded set is silently short, and on a failed read it is silently empty. That means sharing grants or approval recipients go missing, with no signal. By contrast, the approvals member screen (`MEMBER_SCREEN_READ_LIMIT`, ~L2999) is already loud.

## Wanted

Measure both first. Then, as #29281 does: page the read to completion when it comes back at its bound (or reuse #29281's completion read if it fits), and make a failed read loud instead of an empty set. Say per site whether that is a narrowing (a call that answered now refuses).

Dedupe: searched `sys_member limit 10000 silent truncation`, `expandRole sys_member limit`, `approval tier recipients cap`; nearest #29281 (org_user_ids). **New.**

Links back: #29281, PR #29356.
